FN-G38FHC6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 296
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 296 as introduced would increase motor vehicle registration and license fee receipts
to the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency, the Public Road and Bridge Fund, and the counties
and municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of off-road or
recreational off-road vehicles that would become registered pursuant to the provisions of this
bill.
Additionally, this bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Revenue to administer the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
